_fixture_meta.description: Location stored-status captured live on a Kia PV5 (2026-10-27) by the reporter of lib PR #1331 and shared with coordinates replaced by 0.0 before sharing; structure and key names unchanged. Captured right after a location update-status request (which woke the car and made the server store the fresh position) returned the new location. The main stored-status tree carries no Location node, so this endpoint is the only location source for such vehicles. 'time' is UTC.
